item.description: Two stores recently closed at Westfield UTC mall in University City.

item.title: UPDATE: Suspect arrested after allegedly chasing child, attempting to steal backpack
item.description: Damari Waller, 30, was arrested Wednesday for allegedly chasing an 11-year-old Lemon Grove Academy student and attempting to steal their backpack.

item.title: Woman accused of fatal PB hit-and-run pleads not guilty
item.description: The suspect in a deadly hit-and-run that killed a six year old in Pacific Beach earlier this month pleaded not guilty in court.

item.title: PHOTOS: Hiker airlifted to safety after suffering ankle injury in Poway
item.description: A woman was rescued by helicopter after suffering an ankle injury while hiking on Mount Woodson in Poway, California.

item.title: La Costa Canyon geometry teacher arrested for allegedly possessing child pornography
item.description: Joseph Zyburt, a long-serving geometry teacher from La Costa Canyon High School, was arrested for allegedly possessing child pornography, shocking the community and prompting the school to take action.

item.title: Debate over Balboa Park parking fees: Access or revenue?
item.description: Public advocate Shane Harris has proposed a "free Sundays" initiative to ensure access to Balboa Park for all residents, following the implementation of new parking fees that have led to a decline in museum attendance and increased struggles for local businesses.

item.title: Attorney investigates possible civil litigation in fatal hit-and-run of 6-year-old boy
item.description: A civil litigation attorney is investigating whether to file a civil lawsuit in the case of the fatal hit-and-run that killed 6-year-old Hudson O'Loughlin in Pacific Beach, while the driver, Tiffany Sanchez, has pleaded not guilty to all three charges against her.

item.title: Humane Society holds special graduation for cat who survived coyote attack
item.description: Kyle, a 2-year-old orange tabby cat who survived a coyote attack, has successfully completed his six-month rabies quarantine and is now officially cleared for adoption.

item.title: All lanes on southbound I-15 in San Diego reopen after multi-vehicle crash
item.description: A crash involving multiple vehicles caused all lanes of southbound Interstate 15 near Balboa Avenue to be blocked Wednesday afternoon.
